1110 TAKE NOTICE that there was an error in notices Nos. 24489 and 24491 in Gazette No. 117 of 2022, dated
22nd December, 2022. The liquidation dates were incorrect. The corrected notice is as follows:
Omran Securities Limited
(In Voluntary Liquidation)
(BBC NO. 1757480)
24489 NOTICE is hereby given pursuant to Section 204(1)(b) of the BVI Business Companies
Act, 2004 that the Company is in voluntary liquidation. The voluntary liquidation commenced on
the 12th December, 2022. The Liquidator is Johannes Jeremias Boshoff of Harneys Westwood &
Riegels Singapore LLP, 138 Market Street, #24-04 CapitaGreen, Singapore 048946.
Dated 12th December, 2022
Johannes Jeremias Boshoff
Liquidator
